write_model: Heap plus MVCC tuple chains plus per-AM indexes
insert_path_speedups: HOT page-local updates, BRIN range summarization, GIN pending-list bulk path
update_delete_speedups: HOT pruning, bottom-up index deletion, visibility-map-aware cleanup
index_maintenance_speedups: AM-specific exact/lossy rules, posting-list compression, deduplicating B-tree pages
reliability_and_publication_pattern: WAL plus visibility metadata plus vacuum/pruning lifecycle
best_borrow_for_scratchbird: Suppress index churn when indexed values do not change; make index trust explicit by family
major_caution: Do not make WAL or visibility-map semantics the platform truth for ScratchBird

write_model: MGA record versions owned by central VIO layer
insert_path_speedups: Exact record-version ownership keeps insert semantics simple and local
update_delete_speedups: Backout, version chase, savepoint-aware undo, background garbage collection
index_maintenance_speedups: Exact transactional index cleanup, duplicate checking, compressed jump-node B-tree, parallel index creation
reliability_and_publication_pattern: Transaction and VIO ownership are the publication truth
best_borrow_for_scratchbird: Keep visibility, backout, and exact index cleanup under one owner
major_caution: Avoid donor-style monolithic coupling as the only extensibility path

write_model: Clustered primary storage plus secondary indexes plus undo/purge
insert_path_speedups: Change buffer for cold non-unique secondary pages, optimistic insert paths
update_delete_speedups: Undo plus purge remove obsolete versions and stale secondary entries when safe
index_maintenance_speedups: Secondary-index delta buffering, optimistic/pessimistic B-tree operations, MRR/ICP on read side
reliability_and_publication_pattern: Mini-transaction and redo discipline with background merge/purge
best_borrow_for_scratchbird: Cold-page secondary-index buffering and strict purge eligibility checks
major_caution: Do not adopt redo or mini-transaction recovery as ScratchBird's architectural truth

write_model: InnoDB lineage with stronger upgrade and metadata-compatibility emphasis
insert_path_speedups: Optimistic/pessimistic B-tree paths; historical change-buffer lessons
update_delete_speedups: Purge eligibility checks, instant-format metadata handling, online-DDL rigor
index_maintenance_speedups: Startup upgrade of old buffered state, instant page markers, defensive metadata transitions
reliability_and_publication_pattern: Startup compatibility gate before enabling normal write traffic
best_borrow_for_scratchbird: Upgrade-time safety rules and instant-metadata discipline
major_caution: MariaDB itself removed the change buffer, showing the long-term maintenance risk of over-complex deferral machinery

write_model: Collection scan plus external sort plus bulk-loaded index plus intercepted concurrent writes
insert_path_speedups: Sorted bulk load into storage-engine index; concurrent writes continue
update_delete_speedups: Side-write drain phases, deferred duplicate-key and skipped-record rechecks
index_maintenance_speedups: Hybrid builds use side tables instead of random foreground index mutation
reliability_and_publication_pattern: Two-phase commit, commit quorum, final X-lock publish
best_borrow_for_scratchbird: Shadow-build, side-write interception, staged drain, and publish
major_caution: Do not copy oplog-specific or replica-set-specific mechanics literally

write_model: Commit log plus memtable plus immutable SSTable plus compaction
insert_path_speedups: Append to commit log and memtable; per-disk flush writers
update_delete_speedups: Tombstones and old versions retired during compaction
index_maintenance_speedups: Storage-attached index lifecycle follows SSTable lifecycle
reliability_and_publication_pattern: Immutable SSTable publication plus commit-log recovery
best_borrow_for_scratchbird: Immutable generation publish and storage-attached summary/index design
major_caution: Do not replace ScratchBird lineage truth with LSM compaction truth

write_model: Insert-created parts plus background part merges
insert_path_speedups: Compact parts for small frequent inserts; sort once per part
update_delete_speedups: Background merges and TTL actions retire or collapse older data
index_maintenance_speedups: Sparse primary-key marks, granule skip logic, part-level secondary structures
best_borrow_for_scratchbird: Immutable part publication and granule-level pruning metadata
major_caution: MergeTree visibility semantics are not a transactional donor for ScratchBird

write_model: Appendable row groups plus checkpointed storage plus delta indexes during checkpoint
insert_path_speedups: Append into row groups with tight locality
update_delete_speedups: Delete batching by row-group vector with undo-buffer registration
index_maintenance_speedups: Index checkpoint deltas merged back into main index after checkpoint
reliability_and_publication_pattern: Checkpoint flag in WAL plus root-meta validation plus WAL replay fallback
best_borrow_for_scratchbird: Checkpoint-time delta merge and row-group-local batching
major_caution: Do not import DuckDB's checkpoint/WAL model as ScratchBird's cluster-wide truth

write_model: Lucene segment writer plus translog plus refresh and merge
insert_path_speedups: Foreground writes hit Lucene writer while durability goes through translog
update_delete_speedups: Soft deletes and version map keep updates visible without synchronous full cleanup
index_maintenance_speedups: Background merges and flush-after-merge free transient disk and collapse segment debt
reliability_and_publication_pattern: Atomic translog checkpoint file plus generation roll
best_borrow_for_scratchbird: Small atomic checkpoint metadata and explicit separation of durability from query visibility
major_caution: Refresh semantics and shard translog rules are not direct transaction semantics

write_model: Transactional graph store plus native GBPTree indexes
insert_path_speedups: Batched single-threaded writer mode for consecutive inserts
update_delete_speedups: Index updates are collected per transaction and applied in combined jobs
index_maintenance_speedups: WorkSync combines concurrent update streams; explicit add/change/remove index modes
reliability_and_publication_pattern: Apply barrier is the combined index-update batch
best_borrow_for_scratchbird: Batch index-apply layer and dedicated batched-writer mode
major_caution: Do not overfit property/label graph assumptions into a relational core

write_model: In-memory object store with adaptive encodings and optional AOF durability
insert_path_speedups: Choose smallest encoding first: intset, listpack, dict, skiplist, compressed radix nodes
update_delete_speedups: Lazy unlink and background free reduce foreground delete stalls
index_maintenance_speedups: Encoding upgrades happen only when thresholds are crossed
reliability_and_publication_pattern: AOF fsync and rewrite choose durability/latency point
best_borrow_for_scratchbird: Adaptive encoding thresholds and lazy reclamation
major_caution: Single-threaded in-memory design is not a durable relational storage model

write_model: Growing segments in write buffer, sealed segments for sync and index build
insert_path_speedups: Buffer inserts into growing segments with per-segment metadata and bloom filters
update_delete_speedups: Delete data is buffered and shipped with segment sync work
index_maintenance_speedups: Policy-driven sealing, per-segment bloom filters, async sync packs
major_caution: Segment lifecycle is useful for ANN families, not as the only base table model

write_model: Buffered WAL files plus mutable table chunks plus snapshot/parquet persistence
insert_path_speedups: Buffer writes, persist WAL quickly, flush larger parquet batches later
update_delete_speedups: Chunk snapshotting moves mutable state out of hot path; schema has soft-delete states
index_maintenance_speedups: Checkpoint and snapshot flow amortizes expensive storage writes
reliability_and_publication_pattern: WAL persistence first, then snapshot/parquet/object-store promotion
major_caution: Object-store-first durability is not a direct fit for ScratchBird primary storage
